text: The Toronto Investment Board (the Board) at their meeting of May 31, 2018 requested the Acting Executive Director, Corporate Finance to work with Aon to provide several specific examples of investing in infrastructure sector including timelines. This report contains several specific examples of actual investments in the infrastructure sector with timelines that might be considered by the Toronto Investment Board. The content of these examples is considered confidential.

The Toronto Investment Board: 1. Directed that Confidential Appendix A to Attachment 2 to the report (June 11, 2018) from the Acting Executive Director, Corporate Finance remain confidential in its entirety, as it contains information that involves the security of property belonging to the City or one of its agencies or corporations.
